A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that
the complete D-brane actions are determined by the geometry and topology of the ambient space, and by the embedding of the brane world-volume into this space.
the curvature corrections to the D-brane actions can be derived from a simple one-loop computation in M-theory, which is the only consistent theory of quantum gravity.
the D-brane actions are not uniquely fixed by the symmetries of the ambient geometry.
